pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' asserts the seeded items are all 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
The 'AC-2' test marks item 2 done and checks that both / and /?view=open list only First and Third in id order. The query is ORDER BY id.
The 'AC-3' test marks items 3 and 1 done and checks that the done view lists '✓ First item' then '✓ Third item'.
The 'AC-4' test checks the all view lists all three items in id order, with only the done one marked.
The 'AC-5' test asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
The 'AC-6' test checks that Open, closed, an empty value and __proto__ all return 400 with no <li>. src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn to guard against prototype keys.
The 'AC-7' test checks Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views once the table is empty. src/index.js runs a COUNT query to tell an empty table from an empty view.
traffic/routes.json lists both views, and the 'AC-8' test asserts they are present. The traffic worker builds its URL as app.internal+path, so the query is kept.

findings.what: The README describes the views but not that any other view value answers 400.
findings.fix: Add a short note that an unknown ?view= value returns 400.

findings.what: I could not run the suite because vitest is not installed in this checkout, so test results are unverified. Every state-table row does have a test.
findings.fix: Run npm install, then npm test, in CI.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's decisions: it opens on open items and the view is a query parameter. Nothing beyond the ask, apart from the traffic-route query check, which the PR discloses.
All 8 acceptance items are named by tests and all 6 state rows have tests. The spec was added in the same change, with the go dated 2026-10-12, and no later commit edits it.
The tests assert behaviour and reset the DB before each test. The existing traffic fake app was adjusted, not loosened. Tests were not run here because vitest is missing.
The README is updated for the views. It does not mention the 400.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn and the SQL fragments come from a fixed table, so there is no injection. Titles are escaped.
The query parameter is only used as a key into a fixed map. The relaxed route regex still refuses spaces and #.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no stylesheet or UI framework files in the diff.
The diff has no UI flow files beyond the plain server-rendered page; the PR states no browser was available.
The PR's claims match the diff: the traffic check, the 400 on other values, no tests deleted, and the migration. The CI and screenshot claims cannot be checked from the repository.
